capitalization: Always write the product name as 'Nomi' (capital N, lowercase omi). Never 'NOMI' or 'nomi' in prose.
urlStyle: On-site links use lowercase slugs, hyphenated, no trailing slash. Absolute external URLs use https.
headingStyle: Sentence case is fine. One H1 per page; H2s for sections; H3s only for sub-lists inside a section.
listStyle: Use bullets for benefits/tips. Use numbered lists only for ordered steps (e.g. how-to).
codeAndMath: Leave equations and code in their original form. Translate only prose.
ctaStyle: CTA short, specific, honest. Always include a verb (try/start/generate/switch/study). Never hype words.
comparisonTone: Balanced. Name the competitor's real strengths. 'Choose [competitor] if…', 'Choose Nomi if…'. Never 'Nomi is the best'.
numbersPolicy: Spell out one through nine, use digits for 10+. Use digits for measurements, prices, and version numbers.
